I got fired at 23. By 25, I’d built a content agency close to $1M. All from content I strategically stole. 

Here’s the content strategy framework I used, and where I stole every piece of it.

Austin Kleon’s “Steal Like an Artist” changed how I built my entire LinkedIn strategy. Not copying. Not imitating. Collecting, studying, and transforming what works into something only I could make.

IN THIS VIDEO I BREAK DOWN:
 The difference between a good theft and a bad theft
 The 3 sources I collected from before ever posting
 How sales calls became my best content source
 The exact workflow we use at Distinctiva to extract expertise
 The 5-step framework: Collect, Copy, Transform, Adapt, Compound
 How to build a content system that compounds over time

I also share how I went from working inside an SEO agency to building a content agency that turns founders and executives into the recognizable voice in their industry.
